description: chart kinds with their metrics and defaults
name: chart_kinds

kinds.description: Recorded spend to date next to each team's internal allocation (or allocation minus recorded spend with metric `remaining`).
Full-period projection from the ForecastProvider next to each team's allocation (or projection minus allocation with metric `gap`). No projection rows when unavailable.
Recorded spend per team stacked by cost category; included and unpriced usage are never spend (metric `record_count` counts usage records in every category).
Saved allocations per team across budget versions, each linked to its decision (or the envelope total per version with metric `envelope_total`).
